evidence.excerpt: I’m Nick, founder of Drafted ( https: www.drafted.ai ). We’re training models that generate residential architecture from structured design constraints. Product demo: https: www.youtube.com watch?v=8QkJ7jNU9y4 Residential architecture is still one of the most expensive, slow, and inaccessible creative processes in the world.
